propositions: gitutil.py at 798/800 lines has only 2 lines of headroom and blocks new changes; splitting along the git-lock-contention seam reduces it to 373 lines within the 200-500 target.
git-lock-contention policy decision logic must move to a new git_locking.py module (target 484 lines) while git execution logic stays in gitutil.py.
Moved function bodies must be byte-identical to originals; retained gitutil functions differ only in docstring and import block, with no executable line changes.

Re-exports from gitutil must preserve production importers and test consumers that read moved names, while structural protection (raising=True on monkeypatch.setattr) prevents silent failures for names deliberately excluded from re-exports.
monkeypatch.setattr retargets to git_locking must be load-bearing, proven via mis-target AttributeError tests, seeded mutants, and invocation probes rather than green-suite assertions.
getattr reads with default values must be proven with sentinel defaults rather than value comparison, since fallthrough to the real constant value is invisible without a sentinel.
